# CU-ID: arch
# CU-TYPE: ArchCU
# DTR-COORDINATES: 

Hexagonal architecture for the Scala Hypothesis Engine. Layer order DOMAIN, APPLICATION, INFRASTRUCTURE, CONTROL. Domain holds immutable models only. Application owns ports and services. Infrastructure provides adapters. Control performs DI wiring and CLI entry. No cross-layer imports: domain imports nothing from application/infrastructure/control; application imports domain only; infrastructure imports application and domain; control imports all. Dependencies are injected through constructors; no service locators. The ledger report is a read-only projection of ledger state built in application and encoded in control; it never decides an outcome. Severity: every CU is CRITICAL unless downgraded explicitly.

IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS:
1. Apply these rules to every file authored by this batch: domain at hypothesisengine/domain, application at hypothesisengine/application, infrastructure at hypothesisengine/infrastructure, control at hypothesisengine/control.

Prove: `grep -c 'package hypothesisengine' hypothesis-engine/src/main/scala/hypothesisengine/domain/Model.scala` prints 1.

Do NOT touch: hypothesis-engine/src/test/**, .LLMDD/**

Stop when: every authored source file sits in its layer package and no import crosses a layer boundary.

# CU-ID: legend
# CU-TYPE: LegendCU
# DTR-COORDINATES: 

LEGEND for feat-18. CU means Computational Unit. CU folder is the per-CU directory named after the cu id. COORDINATES.itr names the baseline DTR keys the CU touches. REQUIREMENTS.itr names the feature criteria the CU delivers. IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS.itr holds numbered steps, each with an exact file path, a complete fenced code block, a Prove line, a Do NOT touch list and a Stop when line. ACCEPTANCE.itr names the spec test ids with commands and expected results. Hypothesis is a candidate correctness claim carrying an Advisor-authored justification. Gate floor is the inclusive engine minimum of 0.85 for gate_probability_for_correctness. LedgerStageReport is the read-only per-stage projection of ledger state containing the hypothesis, its coordinates, justification, posterior, gate, gap, decision and cumulative StageDecision history. Stage is one engine invocation, numbered by the count of prior decision records plus one. Conversation record is the feature artifact holding verbatim report echoes. Report echo is the exact report block pasted into the design conversation. Verdict line is the GREEN_LIGHT, RED_LIGHT or ADVISOR_ACTION_REQUIRED line printed by the engine.

```scala
object CoverageFalsificationEvaluator {
  val ceiling: Double = 0.95d
  private val decay: Double = 0.5d

  def record(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, posterior: Double, at: Instant): ProbabilityCalculation =
    ProbabilityCalculation(hypothesisId, posterior, at)

  def update(prior: Double, coordinates: Vector[DtrCoordinate], evidence: Vector[(DtrCoordinate, Boolean)]): Double =
    if evidence.isEmpty then prior
    else
      val grouped: Map[DtrCoordinate, Vector[Boolean]] = evidence.groupMap(_._1)(_._2)
      val failed: Set[DtrCoordinate] = grouped.collect {
        case (coordinate, outcomes) if outcomes.contains(false) => coordinate
      }.toSet
      def evidenceFor(coordinate: DtrCoordinate): Double =
        if failed.contains(coordinate) then 0.0d
        else
          val passes: Int = grouped.getOrElse(coordinate, Vector.empty).count(identity)
          if passes == 0 then 0.0d else 1.0d - math.pow(decay, passes.toDouble)
      val denominator: Double = coordinates.length.toDouble.max(1.0d)
      val coverage: Double = coordinates.map(evidenceFor).sum / denominator
      val score: Double = prior + (ceiling - prior) * coverage
      if failed.nonEmpty then math.min(score, prior) else score
}
```

```scala
object Main:
  given Decoder[HypothesisId] = Decoder.decodeString.map(HypothesisId.apply)
  given Decoder[Hypothesis] = Decoder.forProduct6(
    "id", "statement", "dtr_coordinates", "gate_probability_for_correctness", "prior", "justification"
  )(Hypothesis.apply)

  private def ledgerPath: String =
    sys.props.getOrElse("hypothesis-engine.ledger.path", "ledger.db")

  private def usage(): Unit =
    System.err.println("usage: Main <hypothesis.json> <experiments.jsonl> | init [path] | cleanup <hypothesis-id>|--all")

  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit =
    val code: Int = run(args)
    if code != 0 then System.exit(code)

  def run(args: Array[String]): Int =
    args.headOption match
      case Some("init") => runInit(args.drop(1).toVector)
      case Some("cleanup") => runCleanup(args.drop(1).toVector)
      case _ => runExamine(args)

  private def runInit(rest: Vector[String]): Int =
    val path: String = rest.headOption.getOrElse(ledgerPath)
    val ledger: Ledger = new SqliteLedger(path)
    ledger.initialize() match
      case Left(error) =>
        System.err.println("INIT_FAILED " + error)
        2
      case Right(_) =>
        println("INIT_OK path=" + Paths.get(path).toAbsolutePath.normalize.toString)
        0

  private def runCleanup(rest: Vector[String]): Int =
    val ledger: Ledger = new SqliteLedger(ledgerPath)
    rest match
      case Vector("--all") =>
        ledger.deleteAllData() match
          case Left(error) => System.err.println("CLEANUP_FAILED " + error); 2
          case Right(_) => println("CLEANUP_ALL_OK"); 0
      case Vector(id) =>
        ledger.deleteHypothesisData(HypothesisId(id)) match
          case Left(error) => System.err.println("CLEANUP_FAILED " + error); 2
          case Right(_) => println("CLEANUP_OK hypothesis=" + id); 0
      case _ =>
        usage()
        2

  private def runExamine(args: Array[String]): Int =
    if args.length < 2 then
      usage()
      2
    else
      val hypothesisJson: String = new String(Files.readAllBytes(Paths.get(args(0))), "UTF-8")
      val hypothesis: Hypothesis = decode[Hypothesis](hypothesisJson).fold(
        error => throw new IllegalArgumentException(error.getMessage), identity)
      val definitions: Vector[ExperimentDefinition] = Files.readAllLines(Paths.get(args(1)).toAbsolutePath).toArray(new Array[String](0)).toVector
        .filter(_.trim.nonEmpty)
        .map { line =>
          ExperimentDefinitionCodec.parse(line).fold(
            error => throw new IllegalArgumentException(error), identity)
        }
      val clock: Clock = new SystemClock
      val ledger: Ledger = new SqliteLedger(ledgerPath)
      val engine: HypothesisEngine = new HypothesisEngine(new ProcessAdapter(clock), ledger, clock)
      val outcome: ExaminationOutcome = engine.execute(hypothesis, definitions)
      import ReportJson.given
      val block: String = outcome.report.asJson.noSpaces
      println(block)
      val hypothesisPath: String = args(0)
      val reportPath: java.nio.file.Path = Paths.get(
        if hypothesisPath.endsWith(".hypotheses.json")
        then hypothesisPath.stripSuffix(".hypotheses.json") + ".ledger-report.jsonl"
        else hypothesisPath + ".ledger-report.jsonl"
      )
      Files.writeString(reportPath, block + System.lineSeparator, StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.APPEND)
      outcome.decision match
        case Decision.Green(_, posterior, gate) =>
          println("GREEN_LIGHT posterior=" + posterior + " gate=" + gate)
        case Decision.Red(_, posterior, gate, breakpoints, fix) =>
          println("RED_LIGHT posterior=" + posterior + " gate=" +
            " breakpoints=" + breakpoints.map(breakpoint => DtrCoordinate.value(breakpoint.coordinate)).mkString("|") +
            " fix=" + fix.description)
        case Decision.Blocked(reason) =>
          println("ADVISOR_ACTION_REQUIRED missing=" + reason.missing.mkString("|") +
            " corrections=" + reason.corrections.mkString("|"))
      0
```

```scala
package hypothesisengine

import hypothesisengine.application.CoverageFalsificationEvaluator
import hypothesisengine.application.ExaminationGate
import hypothesisengine.domain.*
import org.scalatest.funsuite.AnyFunSuite
import org.scalatest.matchers.should.Matchers

final class NewEvaluatorSpec extends AnyFunSuite with Matchers:
  private val prior: Double = 0.5d
  private val coords: Vector[DtrCoordinate] = Vector(
    DtrCoordinate("TYPE.a.Domain"), DtrCoordinate("TYPE.b.Domain"),
    DtrCoordinate("TYPE.c.Domain"), DtrCoordinate("TYPE.d.Domain"))

  private def passes(coordinate: DtrCoordinate, count: Int): Vector[(DtrCoordinate, Boolean)] =
    Vector.fill(count)((coordinate, true))

  test("T3 per-coordinate evidence diminishes and stays below the ceiling") {
    val e1: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords.take(1), passes(coords.head, 1))
    val e2: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords.take(1), passes(coords.head, 2))
    val e3: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords.take(1), passes(coords.head, 3))
    val e100: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords.take(1), passes(coords.head, 100))
    (e1 - prior) / (0.95d - prior) shouldBe (0.5d +- 1e-9)
    (e2 - prior) / (0.95d - prior) shouldBe (0.75d +- 1e-9)
    (e3 - prior) / (0.95d - prior) shouldBe (0.875d +- 1e-9)
    e100 should be < 0.95d
    (e2 - e1) should be > (e3 - e2)
  }

  test("T4 coverage is the mean over all declared coordinates") {
    val threeOfFour: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords, coords.take(3).flatMap(c => passes(c, 3)))
    val fourOfFour: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords, coords.flatMap(c => passes(c, 3)))
    threeOfFour should be < 0.85d
    fourOfFour should be >= 0.85d
    val oneAThreeB: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords.take(2), passes(coords(0), 3) ++ passes(coords(1), 1))
    val zeroB: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords.take(2), passes(coords(0), 3))
    oneAThreeB should be > zeroB
  }

  test("T5 a single failure caps the score at the prior and forces RED") {
    val evidence: Vector[(DtrCoordinate, Boolean)] = coords.flatMap(c => passes(c, 5)) :+ ((coords.head, false))
    val score: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords, evidence)
    score shouldBe (prior +- 1e-9)
    val hypothesis: Hypothesis = Fixtures.hypothesis.copy(coordinates = coords, gate = 0.85d, prior = prior)
    ExaminationGate.decide(hypothesis, score, Vector.empty) match
      case Decision.Red(_, _, _, _, _) => succeed
      case other => fail("expected RED, got " + other.toString)
  }

  test("T6 finite evidence stays below one and no evidence yields the prior") {
    val score: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords.take(1), passes(coords.head, 100))
    score should be <= 0.95d
    score should be < 1.0d
    CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords, Vector.empty) shouldBe (prior +- 1e-9)
  }

  test("T8 identical inputs give identical scores") {
    val evidence: Vector[(DtrCoordinate, Boolean)] = coords.take(2).flatMap(c => passes(c, 2))
    val first: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords, evidence)
    val second: Double = CoverageFalsificationEvaluator.update(prior, coords, evidence)
    first shouldBe second
  }
```

```scala
package hypothesisengine

import hypothesisengine.control.Main
import java.nio.file.{Files, Path}
import java.sql.{Connection, ResultSet, Statement}
import org.scalatest.funsuite.AnyFunSuite
import org.scalatest.matchers.should.Matchers

final class CliSpec extends AnyFunSuite with Matchers:
  private val propertyName: String = "hypothesis-engine.ledger.path"

  private def withTempLedger(testBody: String => Unit): Unit =
    val previous: Option[String] = Option(sys.props.get(propertyName))
    val file: Path = Files.createTempFile("feat19-ledger", ".db")
    Files.delete(file)
    sys.props(propertyName) = file.toString
    try testBody(file.toString)
    finally
      previous match
        case Some(value) => sys.props(propertyName) = value
        case None => sys.props.remove(propertyName)
      Files.deleteIfExists(file)

  private def open(dbPath: String): Connection =
    java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:" + dbPath)

  private def scalar(dbPath: String, sql: String): Int =
    val conn: Connection = open(dbPath)
    try
```
